description: This Java class manages JWT-based authentication within the OFBiz framework, including token creation, validation (both local and via external JWK provider), and session handling for SSO. It handles JWT signing, verification, tenant checks, and token refresh mechanisms.

classes.name: JWTManager
classes.description: Class handling JWT token issuance, validation (including JWK external validation and HMAC fallback), and session management for OFBiz-based SSO.

methods.name: getJwkProvider
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached JwkProvider for a given delegator, fetching JWKS URI based on issuer property.

methods.name: checkJWTLogin
methods.description: Main preprocessor that checks for JWT in request headers, validates it, retrieves corresponding user, and logs in if valid, supporting server-to-server SSO.

methods.name: getJWTKey
methods.description: Retrieves the secret key for local HMAC JWT signing, enforcing minimum length.

methods.name: getAuthenticationToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token upon successful username/password login, storing it in request attribute.

methods.name: getHeaderAuthBearerToken
methods.description: Extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates a JWT token, either through external JWK provider with issuer validation or local HMAC verification, returns claims or error.

methods.name: validateToken (overload)
methods.description: Same as above but with default keySalt.

methods.name: createJwt
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with given claims and expiration.

methods.name: createJwt (overload)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with claims using default expiration.

methods.name: createJwt (full parameters)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with claims, optional keySalt, and specified expiration.

methods.name: checkTenant
methods.description: Ensures tenant consistency for multi-tenancy or cross-server validation.

methods.name: storeUserlogin
methods.description: Stores user login info into the database, logging errors if unsuccessful.

methods.name: getUserlogin
methods.description: Retrieves the UserLogin entity based on userLoginId from JWT claims.

methods.name: validateJwtToken
methods.description: Internal method to validate JWT and log warnings on failure.

methods.name: createRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates a refresh JWT token with longer expiry.

methods.name: validateRefreshToken
methods.description: Validates a refresh JWT token, ensuring it is of type 'refresh'.
